POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Sarah Bedy called the meeting to order at 2:02 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Bedy, Killion, Lie

  Commissioners Absent: Chotiswatdi

Also present: Jennifer Santana, Secretary, Joseph Botelho, Attendee.

Roll call was taken by Jennifer Santana.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56833  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Policy Subcommittee Meeting of
  Monday, September 22, 2025.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Bedy, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Chotiswatdi

2.  25-56832  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the 2025 Homeless Services
  Advisory Committee (HSAC) Policy Recommendation to the Mayor and City
  Council.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Killion, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Bedy, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Chotiswatdi

  • The subcommittee reviewed and discussed the Annual Report and Policy
  Recommendations memo submitted to the Mayor and City Council on
  October 29, 2025. Members requested for additional information from staff
  regarding the HUD reported shelter bed data.
  • Chair Sarah Bedy mentioned the new shower trailer that the city is moving
  forward to purchase. Members additional information regarding this purchase
  and utilization plan.
  • Member Julie shared that Goodwill could be a potential site for a mobile
  shower unit.
  • A member of the public encouraged the subcommittee to think about low
  cost model programs.

3.  25-56834  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the City of Long Beach vacant
  and available parking lots and commercial buildings, including an overview of the
  Vacancy to Vibrancy City website and the District 2 Parking Study.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Bedy, Killion, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Chotiswatdi

  • Chair Bedy opened up the discussion regarding vacant spaces within the
  city. She provided information regarding a overflow parking study done by
  district two. There is no study for city owned spaces.
  • The members discussed interest in alternative low cost congregate shelter
  options along with other options like a shared interim housing model or
  Dormitories.
  • A member of the public suggested the need for a presentation from the staff
  that put together the vacant spaces list that was shared.

4.  25-56835  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the Mayor’s Fund’s potential
  support of a hygiene station pilot program recommended by the Homeless
  Services Advisory Committee.

  • Chair Sarah Bedy discussed the Mayor’s Fund balance and the possibility of
  setting aside some of the funding to support the hygiene pilot program.

  program would be able to submit an application through the Mayor’s Fund.
  • Member Doug added that capitol cost and staffing cost would need to be
  taken into consideration if the subcommittee would like to use the Mayor’s

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Lie, to approve

  Yes:  3  Bedy, Killion, Lie

  • The subcommittee members will look into the plan for the Olympics and the
